title: Числа 18 — Numbers 18
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Господь сказал ___: ты в ответе за осквернение святилища.
cases.translation: The Lord said to Aaron: you are answerable for the defilement of the sanctuary.
cases.explain: The dative marks the addressee of сказать ("said to Aaron") → Аарону.

cases.sentence: Только ты и твои сыновья в ответе за осквернение ___.
cases.translation: Only you and your sons are answerable for the defilement of the priesthood.
cases.explain: The noun depends on осквернение (defilement of…), a possessive relation expressed by the genitive → священства.

cases.sentence: …во всём, что связано с ___ и с тем, что за завесой.
cases.translation: …in everything connected with the altar and with what is behind the veil.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → жертвенником.

cases.sentence: …чтобы мой ___ впредь не падал на израилетян.
cases.translation: …so that my wrath no longer falls on the Israelites.
cases.explain: Гнев is the subject of the verb падал (fell) — the doer takes the nominative → гнев.

cases.translation: …to care for the tent of meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about / concerning) takes the prepositional → шатре.

cases.translation: …to care for the tent of meeting.
cases.explain: Possession — "the tent of meeting" — is expressed by the genitive → собрания.

cases.sentence: Я отдаю ___ в удел все десятины в Израиле.
cases.translation: I give to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance.
cases.explain: The dative marks the recipient of отдаю ("give to the Levites") → левитам (dative plural).

cases.sentence: …кропи жертвенник их кровью и сожги их ___.
cases.translation: …sprinkle the altar with their blood and burn their fat.
cases.explain: Жир is the direct object of сожги (burn); for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative → жир.

reading.ru: Я даю вам священство как дар.
reading.question: What does the Lord give to Aaron and his sons?
reading.explain: The Lord says He gives them the priesthood as a gift.

reading.ru: Всякий посторонний, кто приблизится к святилищу, должен быть предан смерти.
reading.question: What happens to an outsider who approaches the sanctuary?
options: He must be put to death
reading.correct: He must be put to death
reading.explain: Any stranger who comes near the sanctuary is to be put to death.

reading.ru: Я твоя доля и твой надел среди израилетян.
reading.question: What does the Lord say is Aaron's portion and inheritance?
reading.explain: The Lord tells Aaron: I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites.

reading.ru: Я отдаю левитам в удел все десятины в Израиле за их службу при шатре собрания.
reading.question: What do the Levites receive for their service?
options: All the tithes in Israel as an inheritance
reading.correct: All the tithes in Israel as an inheritance
reading.explain: The Lord gives the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance for serving at the tent of meeting.

reading.ru: Это вечный завет соли между Господом, тобой и твоим потомством.
reading.question: How is this covenant described?
reading.explain: The text calls it an eternal covenant of salt between the Lord, Aaron and his offspring.

reading.ru: У тебя не будет ни надела на их земле, ни доли среди них.
reading.question: What would Aaron NOT have among the Israelites?
options: No landholding or share among them
reading.correct: No landholding or share among them
reading.explain: Aaron would have neither an allotment in their land nor a portion among them.
